dedupe_keys.name: photonic wdm switches architecture for multi band optical networks

description: Xia, Shiyi and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. Registered abstracts document physical SOA-based optical add-drop nodes and metro-access network experiments. One study tests C/O-band operation over five 20-km spans at 25 Gb/s and evaluates further node/rate scaling; PAM-4 trials reach 50 and 100 Gb/s over four nodes. A companion prototype uses digital subcarriers and power loading for 40-Gb/s channels through four nodes. Coverage comprises related prototype configurations, which are not assumed to share independent measurement datasets. The source establishes experiments, not a deployed commercial service. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements. These experiments assess communication system performance while varying node count, wavelength bands and transmission rate.
